answer: Price each new identity with a time-locked work escrow: a key only gains attestation weight after it posts unique answers across many epochs, each graded by randomly drawn non-kin reviewers. A sybil farm cannot let clones wander off as one island of copied text; similarity audits flag the cluster and burn every escrow together. Even copper-cheap inference cannot buy time, so N fakes cost N escrows, N times the waiting, and N distinct answers per epoch.
